verdict.rationale: Codex's own docs describe running tasks in parallel in isolated cloud environments, delegating long-running tasks, and starting work from multiple integrations (GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Slack), directly supporting parallel/async agent fleets. However, community reports of tight daily usage limits and quota exhaustion (codex-comm-8, codex-comm-12) suggest practical constraints on sustaining many agents over hours/days, and no evidence quantifies fleet scale or true multi-day autonomy.
